stories.title: Voters Cast Ballots in 2026 U.S. Midterm Elections Amid Predictions of Change
stories.summary: On November 3, 2026, Americans are voting in midterm elections that will determine control of Congress for the final two years of President Donald Trump's term. All 435 House seats, 35 Senate seats, and 36 governorships are at stake. Poll watchers anticipate a potential shift in power, with predictions of a Democratic wave that could challenge the Republican majority.

stories.title: Trump Announces End of $4 Billion Annual Aid to Israel
stories.summary: President Donald Trump stated that the United States will cease its annual $4 billion aid to Israel after the end of this year. He mentioned having reached an agreement with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, asserting that Israel no longer requires this funding. Despite the aid cut, Trump indicated that the U.S. would continue to sell weapons to Israel.

stories.title: Convicted Murderer Jacob Morley Recaptured After Tennessee Prison Escape
stories.summary: Jacob Allen Morley, a convicted murderer, has been recaptured after escaping from the Northwest Correctional Complex in Tennessee. He fled the facility last week and was located near Kansas City, Missouri, by the Missouri State Highway Patrol.

stories.title: Supreme Court Considers Catholic Schools' Participation in Colorado Preschool Program
stories.summary: The Supreme Court is deliberating a case involving Catholic preschools in Colorado that seek to join the state's universal preschool program. The schools argue that their exclusion based on their admissions policy, which does not accept families with gay and transgender parents, is unconstitutional. The court appears to be sympathetic to the Catholic schools' position regarding potential exemptions from Colorado's anti-discrimination rules for taxpayer-funded programs.

stories.title: Russian Strike on Ukrainian Humanitarian Hub Leaves Many Dead and Missing
stories.summary: A Russian airstrike on a humanitarian hub in Ukraine has resulted in at least 31 confirmed deaths, with many others reported missing. The attack targeted a school being used for aid distribution, prompting Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky to label it a 'vile terrorist attack.' In the past 24 hours, the death toll from various attacks has risen to at least 38, with concerns that more victims may be trapped under rubble.

stories.summary: The Supreme Court has rejected the Trump administration's appeal to block over 20,000 ballots in California, which were claimed to include non-US citizens. This ruling effectively ends the administration's efforts to disqualify these ballots just before the midterm elections.

stories.title: Russian Airstrikes on Ukrainian Aid Center Result in 31 Deaths and Many Missing
stories.summary: A Russian bombing raid on a humanitarian aid center in the village of Komyshuvakha, located in southern Ukraine's Zaporizhzhia region, has resulted in at least 31 fatalities. Emergency teams are searching through the debris, with more than 45 residents reported missing. The attack involved the use of large aerial bombs and is part of a broader wave of strikes across Ukraine, which also targeted power plants and hospitals.

stories.title: Democrats Prepare Investigations into Trump Following Midterms
stories.summary: Democrats are strategizing to investigate President Donald Trump's administration and business dealings if they regain control of Congress after the midterms. Their plans include circumventing potential obstruction from the White House and avoiding the impeachment deadlock that characterized Trump's first term. If Republicans lose their majority, Trump's remaining time in office may be dominated by these Democratic-led inquiries, which could even lead to another impeachment.

stories.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy expressed hope that upcoming talks in Abu Dhabi could pave the way for a meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin. During a meeting in Berlin with German Chancellor Friedrich Merz, both leaders emphasized the importance of including the EU in peace negotiations with Russia. Merz voiced skepticism regarding Russia's commitment to a truce.

This decision is part of a growing boycott movement, with six of the 16 participating nations now opting out of matches involving Russia.

The decision reflects the ongoing regional instability, which has also impacted other sporting events, including the Dakar Rally and the WTA Finals.

stories.title: Record $12 Billion Spent on US Midterms Amid Rising Living Costs
stories.summary: The 2026 US midterm elections are projected to cost nearly $12 billion, marking a record high in campaign spending. This surge in expenditure comes as candidates, donors, and super PACs invest heavily in political campaigns, coinciding with rising living costs across the country. Notably, Elon Musk has contributed $446 million to the midterm efforts.

stories.title: US Conducts Strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island Ahead of Midterm Elections
stories.summary: The United States launched limited strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island late on Monday, targeting surface-to-air missiles reportedly used against US assets. This military action occurred just before the crucial midterm elections, amid ongoing diplomatic discussions regarding the conflict. The strikes were confirmed by US Central Command and reported by Iranian social media.
